candidates.change_summary: Change paused() to always return true instead of the internal _paused state variable.
Change paused() to always return false instead of the internal _paused state variable.
Change paused() to return the negation of the internal _paused state variable.
Delete the line that updates the `lrtConfig` state variable, so the config address never changes after deployment.
Replace the lrtConfig assignment with an assignment to a different (non-existent) internal variable, effectively making the update a no-op for the state.
Remove the onlyLRTAdmin modifier, allowing any caller to change the lrtConfig address.
Change the role check to always pass (revert never triggered), removing admin restriction.
Remove the entire modifier body so that any caller passes the check (equivalent to replacing the check with no operation).
Change the event parameter to a constant address so that the emitted event no longer reflects the actual new config, while the state variable still updates correctly.
